header.h1: Vox prepares the visit before it starts.
header.p: Vox interviews, structures, and hands off a brief the clinician can verify and use.

div.div: Patient receives a secure pre-visit prompt before the encounter.
Adaptive interview captures the story in natural language.
Vox turns the story into a structured brief clinicians can start from.
Clinician receives the brief, verifies unknowns, and uses it in the room.
